minimumOS.notes: This run predates the package retention change. It verifies that reopening initializes the saved time, time zone, quiet-hours choice and edit version, and that both contextual UI paths remain usable. The UI uses an isolated denied scheduler and the existing iOS 17 logging workaround.

checks: Existing pending and delivered offer notices survive fire time and cutoff under authorized reconciliation without re-registering a fired notice.
Turning off the reminder or losing OS authorization removes the existing notice.
A deferral notice survives fire time and is removed when its explicit expiry passes.
noticeRetention.scope: Production reminder store and coordinator with an isolated scheduler that distinguishes pending and delivered notices.

remaining: Complete system permission, notification delivery and actual notification tap verification.
Keep an early notification response through foreground and authentication, then recheck the exact current source.
Distinguish ordinary household privacy suspension from real reminder authority loss.
Confirm cold-launch delegate installation and physical-device behavior.

realSystemPermissionProbe.scope: Ordinary app launch with the real notification scheduler and a scratch-only XCTest probe on the source before the reminder settings fix.
realSystemPermissionProbe.observed: The next-shop deferral showed the real notification permission prompt, accepted Allow and reported Reminder scheduled. Reopening the scheduled reminder displayed America/New_York instead of the reviewed America/Chicago. The test stopped at that assertion.
realSystemPermissionProbe.followUp: The minimumOS scope records the focused settings regression on the corrected source. The separate deferral-reminder-readback-20261104 validation confirms end-to-end Chicago and quiet-hours persistence with the real scheduler.
